_: Text of the README 'How it works' figure (v2/where-chock-sits.png), read by where-chock-sits.mjs. Component names are generic: no vendor is named. 'points' are the 12 agentseam events (agentseam.contract.EVENTS) plus the five other places Chock meets the agent or the repository. 'acts' is true where shipped Chock code acts on the point: a filled marker joined to the Chock box; false is a hollow grey marker. tests/test_readme_picture.py asserts the agentseam points equal agentseam.contract.EVENTS and the 'acts' set equals what the engine handles (the agentseam events used in src/chock, the Surface enum, the git script events). 'proof' lists the tests that prove each acting point. Not drawn: the managed-setting and gateway surfaces (not wired).
title: You keep working with your agent as before. Chock checks each action before it lands.

chock.name: Chock
chock.line: a local program; its rules are files in your repository; no model, no tokens

footer: The rules are files in your repository. A person turns them on once with chock sync.
alt: A layered sketch of a coding agent: you send a prompt to an agent loop that works with a model, context, tools, an MCP server and subagents, and your repository and pipeline follow. Every point agentseam exposes is marked on the drawing, and the ones Chock acts on today, the rules in context, before and after each tool, session start, stop, the MCP gateway, commit, push and CI, are filled in accent colour and joined to the Chock box below; the rest are hollow grey.

points.label: session start
points.name: Session start
points.line: arms the hooks from what is committed.

points.label: session end
points.name: Session end
points.line: agentseam exposes this point; no shipped Chock code acts on it.

points.label: prompt submit
points.name: Prompt submitted
points.line: agentseam exposes this point; no shipped Chock code acts on it.

points.label: instructions loaded
points.name: Instructions loaded
points.line: agentseam exposes this point; no shipped Chock code acts on it.

points.label: pre-compact
points.name: Before context is compacted
points.line: agentseam exposes this point; no shipped Chock code acts on it.

points.label: pre-tool
points.name: Before a tool runs
points.line: Chock judges the call: allow, ask or block. A refusal goes back to the model with one line on what to do instead.

points.label: post-tool
points.name: After a tool runs
points.line: records what ran, for checks that read the session. It never changes a verdict.

points.label: tool failure
points.name: After a tool fails
points.line: records the failed call the same way.

points.label: file changed
points.name: A file changes
points.line: agentseam exposes this point; no shipped Chock code acts on it.

points.name: Subagent starts
points.line: agentseam exposes this point; no shipped Chock code acts on it.

points.name: Subagent stops
points.line: agentseam exposes this point; no shipped Chock code acts on it.

points.label: stop
points.name: End of the turn
points.line: reads what the turn left in the working tree and refuses to end the turn on a finding. A backstop.

points.label: rules
points.name: Rules in context
points.line: a short rules block Chock writes into AGENTS.md. Advisory.

points.name: MCP gateway
points.line: a proxy that judges calls to an MCP server.
